parameters.description: Filter to a specific clinic (lab-side only).

roles.description: Recipient roles. Omit / empty = all staff (no PATIENT).

mfaCode.description: 6-digit TOTP code or hex backup code

email.description: Must match the email on file

scope.description: Empty = full proxy. Otherwise list of Action strings to permit.

code.description: Current TOTP code (proves possession before disabling)

ownerEmail.description: Initial owner user. If omitted, the tenant is created without users — invite owner separately via the regular /api/auth/register flow once the slug is known.

ownerPassword.description: Initial password for the owner; omit to require a password-reset flow

withdrawalReason.description: Required when withdrawing a previously granted consent

editedContent.description: Final edited content if decision is EDIT_ACCEPT

isPhi.description: Mark as PHI. Defaults true for clinical categories.

consultationId.description: Optional consultation to anchor the Rx

knownAllergies.description: Patient allergy substances at issue time

currentMedications.description: Patient active medications at issue time

override.description: Override the safety check. Doctor takes responsibility — recorded in audit.

consultationId.description: Optional consultation to attach this chart to

clinicTenantId.description: Clinic tenant id this invoice is billed to.

amountCents.description: Amount paid in centavos. Adds to paidCents.

reference.description: Free-text reference (bank ref, link id, etc.).

delta.description: Signed delta — negative to write off

batchId.description: Specific batch to adjust; defaults to FEFO order

payload.description: Opaque signaling payload (SDP, ICE candidate, chat text)

acceptedPaymentMethods.description: PaymentMethod values: CASH, GCASH, MAYA, BANK_TRANSFER, CARD, HMO, INSURANCE, OTHER

appointmentWebhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL to receive POST events on appointment lifecycle (create / check-in / cancel). Use Zapier/Make/n8n to bridge into Google or Microsoft Calendar.

mfaCode.description: TOTP code if MFA is enrolled

clinicSlug.description: Slug of the clinic tenant to invite. The clinic must already be a CLINIC tenant on the platform; non-tenant email invites land in Phase 2.

inviteNote.description: Optional message shown to the clinic on the invitation card.

parentId.description: Parent category id for nested folders.

defaultPrice.description: Default price in centavos. Required for FIXED pricing mode.

formSchema.description: Dynamic form schema rendered to the clinic at order time.

unitPrice.description: Lab-only override of unit price (centavos). Used with ADJUST_ON_ORDER products.

filename.description: Original filename — passed through to S3 metadata.

phase.description: Target phase (must match one entry from the product's phases array). Omit to advance to the next phase in declared order.

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure (g, ml, pcs, cc).

initialQty.description: Initial quantity in the material UOM.

qty.description: Quantity used in the material UOM.

productId.description: Attach to a specific product. Null = generic.

signatureFileKey.description: S3 key of the uploaded signature image.

clinicTenantId.description: Clinic tenant id. All cases must belong to this clinic.

caseId.description: Optional LabCase id this line bills for.

amountCents.description: Amount in centavos. Defaults to invoice outstanding balance.

externalId.description: External provider id (PayMongo link id, etc.).

caseId.description: Lab case id this plan attaches to.

summary.description: Markdown body the clinic decides on.

filename.description: Original filename — stored on the row.

reason.description: Why the dispute is being opened.

labTenantId.description: Lab tenant id (the lab the case is going to).

dueAt.description: ISO 8601 due date for the case.

formData.description: Form data matching the product's schema.
